transcript: Speaker A: gayi thi cool banne, class mein fool ban ke aa gayi hoon. [Went to be cool, came back a fool.] Speaker B: kaho I made a fool of myself. Par hua kya? My brain going offline.] Speaker B: My brain went blank bolo. Par tumne aadhi English mein jawaab kyun diya? [Say 'My brain went blank'. Why answer in half English?] Speaker A: baaki bachhe aisi farraatedaar English jhaad rahe the ki meri bolti hi band ho gayi. [Other kids spoke such fluent English I was speechless.] Speaker B: Speak Easy app par ao. Yahan roz 15 minute akele mein practice karo. [Come to Speak Easy app. Practice 15 mins daily in private.] Speaker A: par college fees ke baad in classes ka kharcha kahan se laun? [How to afford classes after college fees?] Speaker B: Trial sirf 1 Rupee mein milta hai. Normal English classes se saat guna sasta hai. [Trial is just 1 Rupee. 7x cheaper than normal classes.] Speaker A: kadak! kal class mein main hi aage baithungi. [Awesome! Tomorrow I'll sit in front.] Speaker B: Install button dabao aur apni English journey aaj hi shuru karo. [Press install and start your English journey today.] Speaker C: Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farraatedaar English bolna shuru karein. [Download Speakeasy app now and speak fluent English.]

summary: A college student shares her embarrassment of freezing when asked a question in English in class. An AI avatar corrects her grammar and recommends the Speakeasy app for private daily practice, highlighting its 1-rupee trial. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
